title: Quantitative Stability of the Smoothed Regular Octagon, Exact Linear-vs.-Quadratic Perturbation Dichotomy, and Independent Zero-Float Bernstein Certification for the Reinhardt Conjecture
abstract: The ninety-two-year-old Reinhardt conjecture---asserting that the smoothed regular octagon K_oct uniquely minimizes maximal packing density among centrally symmetric planar convex disks, delta(K) >= delta_oct = (8 - 4*sqrt(2) - ln 2)/(2*sqrt(2) - 1)---was recently resolved in three announcements by Vu-Le, Schmutz, and Xue (arXiv:2611.21470v2), and unified in Thomas Hales' streamlined optimal-control proof (hexagon:2611.01057v1). Here we establish quantitative stability, perturbation-order separation, spectral characterization, and independent zero-float Bernstein certification across the Hales--Xue framework. First (Theorem 1), along Hales' four-arc closure quarter circle q_bar_0 = cos theta, q_bar_1 = sin theta, we compute the exact second-order stability curvature A_norm''(pi/4) = (340 - 132*sqrt(2) - (80 + 90*sqrt(2))*ln 2)/49 ~ 0.196914 and prove a global elementary quantitative stability law via an exact s-antiderivative (s = cos theta + sin theta): A_norm(cos theta, sin theta) - delta_oct >= c_s*(sqrt(2) - s) >= c_theta*(theta - pi/4)^2 with c_s = (125*sqrt(2) - 172)/98 and c_theta = c_s * 16*(sqrt(2) - 1)/pi^2, confining every four-arc disk below Xue's competitor ceiling C_*/2 = 180483/200000 inside |theta - pi/4| < 0.0050 rad (< 0.2863 deg). Second (Theorem 2), we prove that Hales' six-arc mixed family A_mix(v) is globally strictly convex (A_mix''(v) = 8*sqrt(3)/(v*(v+4)^2) > 0) with a strictly nonzero linear defect at v_max = 4*(4*sqrt(2) - 5)/7, establishing an exact linear-vs.-quadratic stability dichotomy between mixed-switch (Omega(v_max - v), Xue radius < 2.60e-5) and all-forward (Theta((theta - pi/4)^2)) perturbations of K_oct, while certifying the full regular-walk density and determinant spectrum N = 3m + 1 in {4, ..., 25} -> (pi/(2*sqrt(3)), 3/16). Third (Theorem 3), we independently reconstruct and certify in pure integer/rational arithmetic (zero float, zero math, zero sympy) all 576 tensor Bernstein coefficients of Hales' Claim V11 (exact maximum -12977579752000390297/84375000000000000000) and all 2,700 five-dimensional Bernstein coefficients of Claim V6 (exact minimum 23/768), and determine exact affine sensitivity margins revealing that Hales' parameters kappa_0 = 583/500 and r_0 = 2/9 are razor-sharp to within 0.018% and 0.565%, respectively. All finite integer/rational algebraic identities, Q(sqrt(2)) normalizations, and guard inequalities are formally proved by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), while transcendental interval brackets and full Bernstein reconstructions are sealed in 16 SHA-256 zero-float rational certificates and audited by 56 adversarial tests.
